technical.acceptance: Sitemap row count equals approved canonical indexable count after QA.

technical.requirement: Audit theme/plugins/templates/widgets/fonts/scripts; remove construction/demos, placeholder content and unnecessary assets; use cache/CDN/image optimization and keep one builder system.
technical.acceptance: Plugin/asset register and staging crawl approved.

technical.acceptance: Mobile/desktop field baseline and post-launch report exist.

technical.requirement: Semantic headings, keyboard navigation, visible focus, form labels/errors, contrast, reduced motion, accessible menus and meaningful alt text; use qualified WCAG 2.2 AA review.
technical.acceptance: Manual keyboard and automated accessibility logs exist; no unsupported compliance claim.

technical.requirement: Track form_start, form_submit, generate_lead, book_call only when real, CTA clicks, phone/email/WhatsApp and CRM lifecycle from lead to win.
technical.acceptance: Test events and CRM IDs are linked; consent settings are documented.

technical.acceptance: Security and privacy checklist signed by owner/counsel.

technical.acceptance: No duplicate geo pages; hreflang omitted until eligible.
